name: Whitefly
description_damage: See: Common Pests of Vegetable Crops

management.cultural: Inspect new plants before purchase: infestations often are introduced. Encourage natural enemies such as ladybird beetles, spiders, and parasitic wasps. Avoid use of broad-spectrum insecticides which reduce populations of these.
